newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline barges firmer in tight supply.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline barges firmer in tight supply.

text.p: NWE gasoline was firmer on Monday in a characteristically slow start to the week, traders said.

One prompt Eurograde barge was heard traded. Of its contents, 600 tonnes of Eurograde were sold at $220 fob ARA, 400 tonnes of Regular unleaded changed hands at $213, and 300 tonnes of Superplus was done at $238.

Dealers said they thought U.S. numbers were sufficiently high to attract European cargoes across the Atlantic, although the poor supply situation meant that little product was expected to move that way.
